    warnings · 3 records
    1. 2024 Yandex divestment and reporting-currency change are structural breaks. These USD recast continuing operations must never be joined to old Yandex consolidated totals.
    2. Recast predecessor-period results are not a mature track record for the current AI infrastructure business. Tiny-base historical growth must not be extrapolated automatically.

model Definition
model Definition · 5 fields
margin
EBIT after ongoing SBC, depreciation and R&D, before interest; no automatic non-GAAP EBITDA substitution
sales To Capital
Incremental revenue / net operating reinvestment, not revenue / gross capital spending
tax
Normalized cash tax rate on positive operating profit; model existing losses/NOLs separately, no cash tax benefit for losses without realizability
stable Reinvestment
g / terminal ROIC of NOPAT; terminal capital efficiency reconciled with margin/tax
sales To Capital Fade
After the explicitly specified capital-efficiency years, fade linearly to terminal ROIC / [terminal EBIT margin × (1 − normalized tax)] by the last forecast year.

wacc Status
Scenario judgment; not estimated market beta/spread. Growth-company operating and financing risk warrant explicit sensitivity, not false precision.
formula
Cost of equity = USD risk-free + assumed beta × chosen ERP; WACC also depends on debt weights/cost and normalized tax. No current beta or debt spread measured.
valuation Gates
valuation Gates · 6 records
  1. The calendar-2026 anchor is a forecast. Value the October 17 stub and remaining spending; do not treat the entire calendar year as future cash flow.
  2. Build a site/cohort model of connected and active MW, commissioning and acceptance lags, utilization, realized prices and GPU generations.
  3. Fund the $20–25bn 2026 capex plan against $3–3.4bn revenue. Customer advances cannot be counted both as working-capital cash inflow and additional financing.
  4. Roll June debt, cash, legal shares, pre-funded warrants and exchanges to the cutoff. June instrument fair values are historical claims estimates, not October intrinsic values.
  5. Model uncommenced leases and minimum power costs consistently with EBIT and capital. Customer pass-through is not assumed.
  6. Separate noncore investments and minority claims from the cloud DCF without adding the same subsidiary cash flows and stake value twice.
uncertainties
uncertainties · 5 records
  1. Eight earnings events contain no formal quarterly revenue-range series. Annual ARR execution improved after the original October 2024 December-ARR forecast missed by 50% at midpoint.
  2. A 12% terminal ROIC below the 15.5% WACC recognizes capital competition despite revenue hypergrowth.
  3. Extending the accounting life from four to five years does not establish the economic replacement cycle.
  4. RPO provides visibility into future service, not fully earned margin or an unconditional cash asset.
  5. New debt and equity can fund capacity while transferring value away from existing common holders.
not Used
not Used · 4 records
  1. Current share price as calibration target
  2. Unverified consensus forecasts
  3. Unwatched video claims
  4. Arbitrary management credibility multipliers

stub Policy
The 2026 bridge is a June-to-December liquidity roll-forward. It is separate from 2027–2036 FCFF and is not the full future FCFF stub at October 17. For an October 17 valuation, estimate cash at that date using post-June actual/known transactions and cash use, then include only remaining October 17–December 31 FCFF. Never charge July–October cash uses twice or add June cash plus raises as current excess cash. The disclosed June balance and full H2 envelope bracket rather than verify current cash.

bounded Model Gaps
bounded Model Gaps · 7 records
  1. Valuation-date stub and post-anchor cash/claims/share roll-forward not integrated; this is a forecast-origin operating EV, not October 17 equity value.
  2. No probability weighting or share-price calibration. Source forecast assumptions are judgments, not reported facts.
  3. Enterprise-to-equity bridge is not computed here; consult the company-specific claim register for resolved evidence, assumptions and remaining uncertainties. Zero is not evidence of absence.
  4. FY2026 forecast anchor requires October 17–December 31 FCFF stub and consistent additional discount interval before any October 17 valuation. June-to-December liquidity envelope is not the remaining stub.
  5. Gross new advances and revenue recognition after 2029 are not separately projected; net movement follows an explicit 25%-of-revenue balance policy.
  6. Cash funding excludes financing, interest, principal, reserves and employee award withholding; customer advance availability is a scenario assumption.
  7. Selected owned-build result is conditional. Compare the capital_paced_partner alternative in shared-evidence.html#optics-funding-reconciliation; lower funding needs imply financing, ownership, capacity-delivery and execution tradeoffs, not a free improvement.

required Changes
required Changes · 4 records
  1. Versioned direct annual schedule input and durable import/save/restore; do not substitute a flexible-profile-generated path.
  2. Operating-only calculation independent of cash, debt and shares, with equity/claims gates retained.
  3. Resolve first-year scalar growth bound without changing 150%/200% annual growth. A core-only bounded unused scalar is a technical fixture, not a permissible silent UI workaround.
  4. Versioned management-forecast anchor kind and as-of stub adapter; never label this anchor actual TTM.

double Counting Rule
Amounts overlap across principal/carrying/fair value, cash/financing, RPO/customer contracts, or rent/capitalized leases. Use mutually consistent treatments.
integration Policy
Use source-date balances only after reconciling operating cash, investments, debt/lease policy, post-balance events and share/award treatment. An unresolved value is null, not zero. A future economic funding deficit is an outcome, not additional face-value debt.

rationale
rationale · 10 fields
growth
85% is a deliberately capped smooth-path hypothesis, not near-term guidance. Latest quarterly growth exceeded 400%, so a single initial rate fading for ten years cannot reproduce the actual capacity ramp.
target Margin
25% is mature EBIT after depreciation, not the reported AI-cloud adjusted EBITDA margin. Reaching it requires sustained utilization, pricing and discipline after the infrastructure buildout.
tax
25% is a normalized eventual profitable-state tax assumption. The engine taxes positive EBIT only and does not model jurisdictional loss carryforwards.
sales Capital
0.6x means $1.67 of incremental net capital per added $1 of revenue. Hardware/data centers are capital-heavy; this normalized ratio is far less demanding than today’s front-loaded spend and cannot finance the actual ramp.
terminal ROIC
12% assumes competitive mature infrastructure returns below the constant 15.5% model WACC. A credible model would separately fade risk and capital intensity as the company matures.
wacc
15.5% nominal USD is a rounded model estimate. Assumed beta 2.1 plus a 2-point equity allowance, 10% target debt and a 4-point debt spread reflect severe execution/funding uncertainty; this is not a verified capital structure or a substitute for default scenarios.
terminal Growth
2.5% nominal USD is a mature-state assumption with limited real expansion, well below the high-growth starting rate and the discount rate; it is not a company forecast.
years
10 years is the common model horizon so company economics can be compared; rates and margins fade over this period. The number is a modeling convention, not a source fact.
other Claims
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not evidence that no additional claims exist. Preserve the existing hard gate: August financing and share exchanges supersede the June balance sheet; post-financing cash, debt, exact shares and equity-linked claims must be reconciled.
other Assets
0 is an unreviewed placeholder, not a statement that all non-operating assets are absent or worthless. Review assets not already included in snapshot cash and avoid double counting.

model Limits
model Limits · 3 records
  1. This exact linear-path assumption set produces negative operating enterprise value. It is an operating stress hypothesis, not a credible standalone fair-value estimate.
  2. Valuation remains withheld. Linear margin recovery from TTM losses, a constant discount rate and growth-only reinvestment cannot represent the announced ramp, funding or GPU replacement cycle.
  3. Old Yandex-group history is not comparable with the post-divestment AI-cloud business.
uncertainties

  2. Convertible financing, warrants, subsidiary claims and future dilution
  3. Owned infrastructure versus partner-funded asset-light mix

scenario Interpretation
scenario Interpretation · 5 fields
company build central
$20bn gross capex annually in 2027–2029; requires robust advances and roughly 50–55% adjusted EBITDA at assumed 3% SBC to preserve the inherited EBIT path. Forward spend, commissioning and unit prices must support this.
capital paced partner
$14bn annual 2027–2029 capex is an efficiency / third-party-funded / paced-build alternative. It cannot simultaneously assume that Nebius wholly funds every >1GW/year deployment and keeps all gross infrastructure revenue. Partner economics and principal-agent revenue policy must be verified.
owned build stress
$28bn/$26bn/$24bn early cash capex and higher D&A; early margin reset so adjusted EBITDA does not exceed 50% merely to preserve a valuation. More capital does not guarantee the inherited sales path.
prepayment Method
Early new advances assumed 20–40% of cash capex. This is an assumption, not 70% deal-count times 50–60% capex; deal-size weighting is undisclosed. Model recognition and eventual advance runoff.
maturity
Other WC 3% of incremental revenue; D&A 30% of revenue after 2029. Advances normalize to 25% of annual sales by 2034 and remain stable in 2035–2036 and perpetuity. Explicit years bear every normalization cash use. Before-advance investment coefficient converges to 1.403125, leaving 1.153125 after normal advance growth; the (1+g) factor aligns current-year revenue increments with forward-funded NOPAT*g/ROIC. Final 2036 reinvestment is exactly NOPAT2036*g/ROIC; 2037 FCFF grows exactly 2.5%, with no exceptional terminal adjustment or extra transition years.
lease And Power Treatment
lease And Power Treatment · 7 fields
operating Convention
Rent and power remain operating costs in EBIT. Do not also subtract their undiscounted sums as debt. New deposits/prepaid rents affect WC; amortization/lease-expense versus cash differences require an annual cash bridge.
commenced Rent2027
235.2
uncommenced Lease Annualized Scale Illustration
1004.508333
power Minimum2027

1781.508333
classification
The uncommenced lease division by 12 is a scale illustration only, not a payment schedule. Leases have differing commencement dates and terms; full-year cash costs may be materially higher/lower. Avoid duplicated power included in rent.
source Ids
source Ids · 1 records
  1. NBIS-H12026-statements
risk Tests
risk Tests · 6 records
  1. At 3-year GPU economic life rather than 5-year accounting life, hardware annual replacement/depreciation need rises by 13.333% of in-service hardware cost, before technology price changes and salvage. Existing margins must be adjusted together with D&A, not net capex alone.
  2. FY2026 $20–25bn spending precedes 2027 revenue and cannot be omitted from an October valuation/funding bridge.
  3. >1GW/year deployment is an operational aspiration; an owned-versus-partner split, equipment cost/MW and active utilization schedule are needed for the chosen pathway.
  4. Advance refunds and late-delivery penalties can cause a liquidity shock while contracted revenue remains unrecognized.
  5. Undrawn authorization, private-stake carrying values, collateralized proceeds and restricted cash are not interchangeable with unrestricted funding.
  6. Default to current actual debt/option/dilution claims, not projected deficits as present debt.

formulas
formulas · 5 fields
fcff
EBIT - cash tax on EBIT + D&A - gross capital cash spending - increase in other operating working capital + increase in customer advances.
capital Cash Spending
PPE/intangible cash purchases + capital supplier advances not already in those purchases + capitalized site purchases. Reclassification of existing prepayments/CIP is not a new cash use.
customer Advances
Ending = opening + new cash advances - recognized prepaid revenue - refunds (+ FX/acquisition adjustments where applicable).
funding Need
Peak cash uses + debt service + cash reserve - opening usable cash - net cash proceeds actually received - available committed credit draws. FCFF alone omits financing costs and principal maturity timing.
terminal
Terminal net reinvestment = terminal NOPAT * stable growth / terminal ROIC; customer-advance movement must be included consistently.
cautions
cautions · 4 records
  1. All future investment schedules are analytical sensitivities anchored to disclosed spending/capacity, not disclosed future budgets. Cumulative peaks are not precise financing forecasts.
  2. Economic FCFF retains SBC as compensation expense. Strict cash liquidity adds back noncash SBC and separately subtracts award withholding/buybacks; modeled 1% AAOI and 3% NBIS SBC addbacks below are illustrations, and dilution must be recognized once.
  3. NBIS 2026 guide is modeled as cash-equivalent capital spending. If guidance includes accrued equipment additions, adjust payment timing and vendor-capital payables before using the H2 bridge. $973.3m H1 additions not yet paid cannot simply be added to cash capex twice.
  4. Annual average capacity and gross deployment are distinct. Margin, replacement cost and commissioning schedules must change coherently when the physical build or economic useful life changes.
as Of Stub Policy
The 2026 bridge is a June-to-December liquidity roll-forward. It is separate from 2027–2036 FCFF and is not the full future FCFF stub at October 17. For an October 17 valuation, estimate cash at that date using post-June actual/known transactions and cash use, then include only remaining October 17–December 31 FCFF. Never charge July–October cash uses twice or add June cash plus raises as current excess cash. The disclosed June balance and full H2 envelope bracket rather than verify current cash.

legacy Adapter Policy
Use explicit gross capital cash spending - D&A + core WC - net customer advance increase. Do not also apply legacy delta-sales/S:C or add forecast deficits as debt. Revenue, WACC, tax, target margin and terminal ROIC otherwise preserved.
requires Explicit Reinvestment Adapter

advance Normalization Complete Year

advance Balance Policy
At year 2029 use explicitly accumulated balance. For years 2030 through maturity-year minus two, linearly fade advance/revenue ratio to 0.25; hold at 0.25 thereafter. For general allowed horizon N starting in 2027: fade = min(1,(forecastYearIndex-3)/(N-5)), where forecastYearIndex is 1-based and greater than 3. Thus N=10 completion is forecast year 8 = 2034.
advance Delta Formula
advanceBalance_t - advanceBalance_(t-1); include in FCFF exactly once. Balance does not run off to zero. Do not add a separate terminal cash adjustment.
growth Investment Timing
Forward-funded: final-year net investment after advances = NOPAT_final * g / terminalROIC. The smooth gross-capital path approaches a before-advance coefficient [(1+g)/impliedTerminalSalesToCapital + 0.25] times current revenue change, not [1/impliedTerminalSalesToCapital + 0.25].
final Year Gross Capex Formula
NOPAT_final*g/terminalROIC + DA_final - coreWCIncrease_final + customerAdvanceIncrease_final
terminal NOPATFormula
revenue_final*(1+g)*terminalOperatingMargin*(1-cashTaxRate)
terminal Investment Formula
terminalNOPAT*g/terminalROIC
terminal FCFFFormula
terminalNOPAT*(1-g/terminalROIC)
terminal Value Formula
terminalFCFF/(WACC-g), measured at end of final explicit year
present Value Formula
Sum explicit FCFF_t / cumulativeDiscountFactor_t, plus terminalValue / cumulativeDiscountFactor_final. At the FY2026 anchor, cumulativeDiscountFactor_final=(1+WACC)^10. For October17 valuation use the same additional FY2026 stub discount interval as explicit FCFF; do not discount terminal from an inconsistent date.
extra Transition Years
0
terminal Adjustment
0
final To Terminal FCFFGrowth Expected
0.025
free Funding Prevention
All normalized advance reductions are charged in explicit years; stable advance growth is subtracted from gross capex/WC investment to deliver the stated net NOPAT*g/ROIC, never added a second time.

double Counting Rule
Amounts overlap across principal/carrying/fair value, cash/financing, RPO/customer contracts, or rent/capitalized leases. Use mutually consistent treatments.
